title: Jared Verse: When defense started having trouble against Seahawks, we didn't know what to do

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jared Verse: When defense started having trouble against Seahawks, we didn't know what to do
sources.description: The Rams had to watch a division rival celebrate a Super Bowl title last Sunday and the pain of that was made all the worse by how close the Rams came to being the NFC's representative in the game.
